gauge.coexact_angular_frequency: sqrt(3) in chosen unit kinetic normalization
gauge.physical_limit: This is a gauge-invariant quadratic DEC Maxwell fixture with A0 enforcing Gauss law, but it lacks a physical continuum/dispersion, photon selection, electric charges or coupling normalization. Other kinetic terms and matter representations may evade its spectral obstruction.
gauge.proof: Use A0 as temporal 0-cochain and E=dot A-B1^T A0, B=B2^T A, S=int(1/2||E||^2-1/2||B||^2)dt. Under A->A+B1^T chi and A0->A0+dot chi, E and B are invariant because B1 B2=0. Gauss constraint is B1 E=0. Edge Hodge decomposition C1=im B1^T(26) + im B2(36) + H1(46); B2^T B2=3I yields K=B2B2^T=3Pcoexact.

local_hamiltonian.exact_theorem: For a strictly null-supported, translation- and SL2(q)-congruence-covariant Hermitian H0, q odd prime power>=5, the earlier orbit theorem implies |exp(-itH0)_(0,d)| <=2/q^2. For H=H0+E, Duhamel gives |exp(-itH)_(0,d)| <= 2/q^2 + |t| ||E||op. Perfect flatness forces |t| ||E||op >= q^-3/2-2/q^2.
local_hamiltonian.scope: The BFGS run is not global, its nonzero residual is NOT a no-go, and a compact logical Clifford circuit is not a null-local continuous-time generator.
